results.title: What drives commodity price booms and busts? - ScienceDirect
results.content: We provide evidence on the dynamic effects of aggregate commodity demand shocks, commodity supply shocks, and storage demand or other commodity-specific demand shocks on real commodity prices. We thereby specify three orthogonal shocks to real commodity prices based on long-run restrictions, namely an aggregate commodity demand shock, a commodity supply shock, and a storage demand or other commodity-specific demand shock. Our results indicate that aggregate commodity demand shocks strongly dominate commodity supply shocks as drivers of commodity price booms and busts over a broad set of commodities and over a long period of time. results.title: Opus IVS establishes global diagnostics development team in Oxford - Garage Wire
results.content: # Opus IVS establishes global diagnostics development team in Oxford. Remote assisted programming allows Opus IVS’ OE brand-specific master technicians to connect directly to complex vehicles. **Intelligent vehicle support company Opus IVS has named its site in Wheatley, Oxfordshire as a global hub for diagnostics and product development.**. Opus IVS helps independent automotive workshops repair complex vehicles safely and fast. A key focus for the Oxford team will be the further development of advanced manufacturer-specific functionality for European vehicles and the extension of its brand coverage through remote assisted programming (RAP). The remote service allows Opus IVS’ OE brand-specific master technicians to connect directly to complex vehicles using OEM-licensed software applications and carry out functions such as flash programming and online coding. “The launch of this global diagnostic development centre continues to underpin our customer’s need for support in repairing complex vehicles.”.

results.title: Global Inflation Factor: How Global Shocks Influence Import Prices - EC[ON]OMY
results.content: # Global Inflation Factor: How Global Shocks Influence Import Prices. However, many don’t realize that a significant part of this inflation is not driven by domestic factors but rather by global economic shocks. How do events like oil price hikes, supply chain disruptions, or geopolitical conflicts shape inflation trends? In this article, we’ll explore how global factors influence import prices, the key drivers of inflation, and what to expect in the coming years. **How Do Global Shocks Affect Import Prices?**. Import prices are influenced by multiple factors, but the most important ones are:. 🔹 Raw material costs – Oil, gas, metals, and food are global commodities, meaning price changes in one country affect the entire world. 🔹 Financial markets – Currency exchange rates, central bank policies, and interest rates directly impact import prices. **Example: How COVID-19 Changed Import Prices**. The COVID-19 pandemic was a perfect example of a global shock that drastically changed import prices. 📌 At first, when lockdowns were imposed, global demand collapsed, causing oil and metal prices to drop. 📌 A shortage of workers, factory closures, and logistical issues pushed prices higher. Commodity prices determine production costs, which directly affect the final price of imported goods. 🌍 Example: Rising oil prices → Higher shipping costs →Increased prices for consumer goods. 📌 Future Outlook: Experts predict continued volatility in energy markets, which will keep affecting import prices. 📌 In 2021 severe congestion at Chinese ports caused months-long delays, raising import prices in the U.S. and Europe. Global economic crises affect central bank policies and impact currency exchange rates. 🌍 Example: A stronger dollar → Higher prices for imported electronics in emerging markets. 📌 Future Outlook: Currency markets might stabilize, but central bank decisions will continue to influence inflation. 🔹 Global factors will remain the primary driver – commodities, logistics, and financial policies will continue shaping import prices. 📌 Bottom Line: Global inflation is not a temporary issue; it has become a key force shaping import prices worldwide. **🌍 Global economic shocks are the main reason behind rising import prices.**. 💡 Inflation may stabilize, but price fluctuations will continue in the long run. ### *Related*. ## Related Posts.

results.content: Commodity Price Shocks, Supply Chain Disruptions and Inflation Rates: Evidence for Four Big Economies Elena Maria Diaz ∗ Juncal Cunado † Fernando Perez de Gracia ‡ July 2023 Abstract This paper estimates the differential impacts of both global supply chain disruptions and commodity price shocks on inflation rates in Germany, Japan, the U.K., and the U.S., and examines their persistence by means of a structural vector autoregressive (SVAR) model over the period from January 1998 to August 2022. Conclusions This paper examines the differential impacts of both commodity price shocks and global supply chain disruptions on the inflation rates of Germany, Japan, the U.K., and the U.S. by means of estimating different SVAR models using monthly data for the period from 1998 to 2022.

results.title: Drew Technologies & Autologic Diagnostics to become Opus IVS
results.content: # Drew Technologies & Autologic Diagnostics to become Opus IVS. DETROIT, Nov. 4, 2019 /PRNewswire/ -- Drew Technologies, Autologic Diagnostics, Farsight, and Bluelink Diagnostic Solutions, companies within the Intelligent Vehicle Support (IVS) division of Opus Group AB (publ), proudly announce they are unifying and will officially be known as Opus IVS. In 2017, Autologic was welcomed into the Opus IVS division alongside Drew Technologies. * **Drew Technologies**, which joined Opus in 2015, is known globally for the development of OEM factory-authorized tools used at dealerships and J2534 flash diagnostic products that give independent service shops the same capabilities as OEMs. * **Autologic**, acquired in 2017, is a leader in vehicle diagnostics providing tools and live diagnostic support that give shops OEM-level coding and programming capabilities across European, U.S. and Asian car brands. * Opus IVS also includes the legacy business **Farsight,** which has strengthened Autologic and Drew Technologies all-brand diagnostic and service capabilities since joining the group in 2017. "In a short time, we have brought these leading companies together within Opus IVS and leveraged the technology from over 30 patents we have pending to help technicians repair complex, modern vehicles. Rebranding as Opus IVS is the next logical step in our companies' evolution allowing us to deliver even more advancements to the market under one unified identity that emphasizes our strengths in innovation and diagnostic support," says Opus IVS President, Brian Herron. **Opus IVS Diagnostic Solutions**Opus IVS offers a unique combination of licensed OEM software and aftermarket diagnostic solutions with expert guidance from OEM-trained master technicians to help shops get the job done. * **DriveCRASH®**, Opus IVS' collision-specific diagnostic platform, is the only OEM-endorsed pre/post-scanning tool to integrate wide OE coverage, on-demand QuickScan, remote programming, calibration and a full diagnostic scan tool with our live team of master technicians to support you. **About Opus**Opus Group AB (publ) (Opus) is a technology-driven growth company in the vehicle inspection and intelligent vehicle support markets.
